gen-dafont-hero-fs-merriweather-sans: Hero draws widely spaced, closed letters with one uniform cut. Merriweather Sans, a plain sans, follows with tall, sturdy lowercase and an e that opens to the right, so a long passage moves along without strain.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-poppins: Poppins reads in smooth, rope-loose curves with no thick-thin flicker. Jelly Crazies is happiest being wobbly and nearly sealed at the bowls, while the plain sans body is happiest staying open, tall and steady.
gen-dafont-nasalization-poppins: Nasalization floats its big lowercase letters well apart, with short ascenders and a c opened like calipers. And Poppins, a plain sans, supplies tall, sturdy lowercase and loose curves that settle the page beneath it.
gen-dafont-neon-poppins: Poppins reads cleanly, with tall, sturdy lowercase and no thick-thin flicker to catch the eye. Neon glows best through its uninterrupted line and open spacing, and the plain sans body does its best work being quietly steady.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-poppins: Words in Neuropolitical look pulled apart letter by letter, glowing in a single line thickness. Poppins, the sans-serif body, has tall, sturdy lowercase and loose curves, so you can raise its size a notch before the pair feels crowded.
gen-dafont-nordic-poppins: Nordic spaces its monoweight letters like brush dabs set far apart, with cramped, closed openings that feel ancient and powerful. Poppins, a plain sans, opens everything back up.
gen-dafont-origami-poppins: Origami looks like a sign-painter's single-stroke brush at constant width, its lowercase heavy as poured lead type. Poppins, a sans, takes over with tall, sturdy lowercase and loose curves, leaving the heading's brushwork to carry the personality.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-poppins: Wide-spaced letters trace a constant-width outline you could follow with a finger. Poppins, a sans, brings tall, sturdy lowercase to meet them, and that steadiness is what the pair does best.
gen-dafont-pixel-operator-fs-merriweathe: Merriweather Sans reads big and sturdy, its tall lowercase carrying an e that opens to the right. Pixel Operator brings fixed-width, code-style blocks with open terminals, and that digital-retro grit against a sans body is the pair's best trick.
gen-dafont-redux-poppins: Wide-set and curvy, Redux enters each round letter with a visible swell and an enlarged lowercase. Poppins, the sans-serif body, keeps its lines flat and unswollen.
